summary: Practise audit sampling, control tests, Excel exception analysis and evidence-based reporting. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Audit techniques training equips internal auditors, audit assistants, supervisors and compliance reviewers to plan and document operational audit tests. You practise defining audit scope and samples, testing controls, analysing transaction exceptions in Excel, and linking evidence to findings and action tracking. Exercises also cover process walkthroughs, workpaper review and root-cause analysis.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits people who prepare, perform, supervise or review operational audit work and need a consistent route from audit procedure to documented conclusion.
modules: Global Internal Audit Standards in Practice
prerequisites: No prior auditing qualification is required. Familiarity with business processes and internal controls will help you connect the exercises to your work.
